label: Hard breach support
text: Thatcher's EMPs clear Bandit, Kaid and Mute so Thermite's charge can open the wall.

label: Alternative breach support
text: Maverick torches a hole to destroy electrified gadgets, or opens the wall himself if Thermite is denied.

label: Hard breach support
text: Thatcher clears denial so Hibana's pellets can open walls and hatches.

label: Hard breach support
text: Thatcher clears denial so Ace's S.E.L.M.A. charges can open the wall.

label: Utility clear for the breach
text: Twitch's shock drones remove batteries, Jäger ADS and cameras before the breach.

label: Find the denial
text: IQ spots Bandit batteries and Mute jammers through the wall so the breach team knows what to clear.

label: Remote breach
text: Kali's LV Explosive Lance destroys denial from range so Hibana can open the wall or hatch.

label: Remote breach
text: Kali clears Bandit and Kaid through the wall, then Ace opens it.

label: Clear before the breach
text: Flores' RCE-Ratero drones destroy utility on the breach wall and in site.

label: Entry / utility clear
text: Both clear utility and open soft walls fast, so the entry gets in before defenders reset.

label: Fast execute
text: Ash clears ADS and opens soft lines while Thermite opens the main wall.

label: Vertical pressure
text: Buck and Sledge open the floor above site and deny defenders their vertical cover.

label: Vertical + breach
text: Buck clears the site from above while Thermite opens the wall below.

label: Shield push
text: Montagne covers Fuze while the cluster charge clears the room behind a wall.

label: Shield push
text: Two shields push together: Blitz flashes, Montagne holds the angle.

label: Smoke + vision
text: Capitão's smoke bolts block sight lines; Glaz sees through smoke and gets picks.

label: Flank denial
text: Airjabs and Trax Stingers lock the flank so the execute team is not shot from behind.

label: Intel pressure
text: Lion scans freeze defenders while Dokkaebi finds roamers and takes cameras.

label: Safe intel on the breach
text: Iana's Gemini Replicator checks the breach angles without risking the breacher.

label: Intel on the wall
text: Zero's Argus camera watches the other side of the wall before Thermite opens it.

label: Turn the denial
text: Brava's Kludge drone turns Bandit's battery or Kaid's claw into an attacker gadget.

label: Hunt the anchor
text: Deimos tracks a defender while Lion pins the rest of the site.

label: Site denial
text: Mute jams drones and breaches; Smoke saves gas for the plant.

label: Wall denial
text: Bandit and Kaid electrify different walls so one breach charge is never enough.

label: Breach denial
text: Mute jams the breach charge and drones; Bandit tricks the hard breacher.

label: Utility denial
text: ADS and Mag-NETs catch grenades and flashes thrown into site.

label: Anchor the breach
text: Jäger's ADS stops the flash before the breach while Bandit denies the charge.

label: Traps on entries
text: EDDs on doors and Welcome Mats under windows punish attackers who rush in.

label: Slow the push
text: Gu mines and Grzmot mines stop attackers rushing through doors.

label: Intel and denial
text: Yokai drones and Evil Eye cameras slow the plant and watch the site.

label: Window control
text: Mira's Black Mirror and Castle's barricades turn site into a controlled hold.

label: Rebuild site
text: Azami rebuilds holes with Kiba Barriers; Thunderbird heals the anchor.

label: Plant denial
text: Volcán shields and gas cover the plant spots in the last seconds.

label: Hold the entry
text: Banshee slows the push; Pulse finds the attacker behind the wall.

label: Camera network
text: Black Eye cameras and Yokai drones give the team intel all round.

label: Deep roam
text: Two invisible roamers draw attackers away from site and buy time.

label: Anti-drone
text: Pests steal drones; Evil Eyes punish anyone who comes in blind.

label: Door lock
text: Razorbloom and Surya gates make doors dangerous to rush.

label: Vertical rotation
text: Oryx moves through hatches while Mira holds site.

label: Find and trap
text: Solis tracks attacker gadgets while Kapkan traps the entries.

label: Anti-flash roam
text: Warden sees through smoke and flashes; Vigil stays off cameras.
